# Interface Specifications

**Generated by:** Interface Designer
**Architecture source:** [../architecture.md](../architecture.md)
**Vocabulary source:** [../vocabulary.md](../vocabulary.md)
**Status:** Draft

---

## Overview

This folder contains the complete interface specifications for `task-marshal`. Every public
type, trait, and function signature is documented here. Corresponding source code stubs in
`src/` are generated from these specifications and must compile cleanly with `cargo check`.

---

## Architectural Map

```
CLI Layer (src/main.rs)
    │
    ├── ConfigLoader   (src/config.rs)
    ├── SourceRegistry (src/sources/mod.rs)
    ├── TaskIdParser   (src/identity.rs)
    ├── TaskSelector   (src/selection.rs)
    └── OutputFormatter (src/output.rs)
         │
         ↓  depends on trait abstraction only
    TaskSource trait (src/sources/mod.rs)
         ↑  implemented by
    ├── LocalFileSource (src/sources/local.rs)
    ├── BeadsSource     (src/sources/beads.rs)
    └── GithubSource    (src/sources/github.rs)
```

**Dependency rules (from [architecture.md](../architecture.md)):**

| Layer | May depend on |
|---|---|
| Business logic (`selection`, `config`, `identity`) | Domain types, `TaskSource` trait |
| Source adapters | Domain types, `TaskSource` trait (to implement), external system libraries |
| CLI Layer | Everything — only layer that wires concrete types to traits |

**Forbidden:**

- Business logic importing any source adapter type directly
- Source adapters depending on each other
- `TaskSelector` receiving raw sources (it receives pre-fetched `TaskSummary` lists)

## Key Design Notes

### Central Abstraction: `TaskSource`

All business logic interacts with task sources exclusively via the `TaskSource` trait defined in
`src/sources/mod.rs`. Source adapter construction happens only in the CLI Layer.

### Canonical Source Key Values

The `SourceKey` enum has three variants with the following string representations:

| Variant | String | TOML section | TaskId prefix |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SourceKey::Local` | `"local"` | `[sources.local]` | `local:TASK-042` |
| `SourceKey::Beads` | `"beads"` | `[sources.beads]` | `beads:bd-a1b2` |
| `SourceKey::Github` | `"gh"` | `[sources.gh]` | `gh:187` |

> **Spec discrepancy note:** `operations.md` uses `"github"` in the TOML priority list and section
> name. The canonical key per [vocabulary.md](../vocabulary.md) and
> [ADR-0003](../../adr/ADR-0003-task-id-encoding.md) is `"gh"`. All implementations must use `"gh"`.

### Subprocess Safety

`BeadsSource` and `GithubSource` accept a `Box<dyn SubprocessRunner>` for all external process
invocations. This enables test doubles that return controlled outputs without spawning real
processes. User-provided values are never interpolated into shell strings.

### Atomic Writes

`LocalFileSource::complete()` writes to a temp file in the same directory as the task file, then
uses `std::fs::rename()` to atomically replace it. A mid-write failure leaves the original
unchanged.

### No Async

All I/O is synchronous. No `tokio`, `async-std`, or similar runtime is used. All `TaskSource`
methods are synchronous (no `async fn`).
